requirements.text: An online catalog for students to check the availability of library items.
The ability for students to borrow, return, and renew items online.
An online system for booking study rooms.
A feature that allows students to view their current loans and any outstanding fines.
Tools for librarians to easily update catalog items.
Mechanisms to track popular items and manage inventory effectively.
Features to manage student accounts, particularly for tracking fines and borrowing history.
Capabilities that enable quick, manual intervention by librarians for handling exceptional situations.
